h2: Pool Repair Canggu – Leaks, Tiles & Pipework Fixed
intro: Looking for Pool Repair Canggu help that solves the root cause rather than patching symptoms? Canggu's rapid villa boom and high groundwater mean most pools here develop leaks, tile damage or pipe issues within their first few years. I assess what is urgent versus cosmetic so you fix the right thing first.

sections.h3: Why Pools in Canggu Fail Early
sections.text: Canggu went from rice paddies to villa-dense streets in a handful of years, and many pools were built fast to meet demand. The high water table left behind by former paddies pushes septic systems harder, while monsoon rains flood pump rooms and overflow channels. In Berawa and Pererenan especially, loose fittings, hidden pipe joints and poorly sloped drains surface within the first couple of seasons. Most call-outs trace back to those build-phase shortcuts rather than normal ageing.

Most Bali pools are now fifteen to twenty years old, so problems shift from cosmetic to structural. I handle leak detection when water level drops overnight, replace cracked mosaic tiles that have popped up around your villa, re-grout sections where sand has worked its way out, and repair or swap pool pipe leaks at the skimmer or return line. If several things are going wrong at once, I walk you through what to address first so you are not paying for everything on day one.

Before any pricing, send a short video or a few close-up photos on WhatsApp showing the problem area — the leaking joint, the loose tile cluster, the discoloured grout line. A quick note on how long it has been happening helps me gauge severity. From those images I can usually tell whether it is a simple patch job or something deeper in the pipework. Pricing depends entirely on scope, so you get a clear figure after I have seen what we are dealing with.

Because Canggu's rainy season hits hard, check your pump room and overflow channel before October arrives. Clear leaves and debris from the skimmer weekly; surrounding fields and daily guest traffic mean they pile up fast. In Babakan, where drainage still struggles after heavy downpours, confirm the pool drain slope has not shifted. A small re-grout every couple of years keeps water out of the substrate and stops tiles lifting in the next wet season.

faq.q: How do I know if my pool leak is structural or just a fitting?
faq.a: Send a short video on WhatsApp showing where the water level drops fastest. Most 'mystery' leaks in Canggu turn out to be a loose skimmer gasket or a hairline crack at a pipe joint rather than a full shell repair.

faq.q: Can you fix loose mosaic tiles without draining the whole pool?
faq.a: For small clusters I work with the water at normal level. If more than roughly a square metre has lifted, a partial drain makes the job cleaner and faster for both of us.

faq.q: Do you cover villas outside central Canggu?
faq.a: I work across Berawa, Batu Bolong, Echo Beach, Pererenan, Babakan and Padonan. For anything further out, send your location on WhatsApp and I will confirm before heading over.
